landing.headline: Finally know what you have, where it is, and what you're ready to let go.
landing.subheadline: VOWVY gives you a searchable memory of your things — at home, at school, or at work. Organize what you have, find it later, share it with helpers, or prepare items to sell.
landing.howAha: Take a photo. VOWVY remembers. Find it whenever you need it.

step1.title: Take a photo
step1.desc: Snap photos of items, boxes, rooms, offices, supplies, samples, or collections.

step2.title: VOWVY helps label it
step2.desc: AI descriptions and tags make things easier to find.

step3.title: Find or share it later
step3.desc: Search by item, note, tag, room, box, or location — or share with a helper.

step4.title: Use it when needed
step4.desc: Prepare items to sell, share with helpers, support a move, or document belongings.

landing.benefitsIntro: VOWVY helps you photograph, organize, find, share, move, and sell the things you own — without trying to remember everything yourself.
landing.benefit1: Remember what's in your boxes — take photos before storing things away.
landing.benefit2: Find things later — search by item, description, note, tag, room, box, or location.
landing.benefit3: Organize a move or cleanup — group items by room, container, collection, or storage area.
landing.benefit4: Keep track of valuables and keepsakes — add photos, notes, and details you don't want to forget.
landing.benefit5: Let AI do the labeling — VOWVY describes and tags photos so you don't have to type everything yourself.
landing.benefit6: Work with helpers — let family, assistants, or collaborators help organize while controlling what they can see.
landing.benefit7: Prepare items to sell — select photos, generate a title and description, and export everything for easier posting on marketplaces or similar sites.
landing.audienceTitle: Useful at home, at school, and at work
landing.audienceIntro: The same simple idea works across many real-life situations.

audience1.title: Home & storage
audience1.desc: Remember what's in boxes, closets, garages, basements, and storage areas.

audience2.title: Moving & dorms
audience2.desc: Track belongings before, during, and after a move.

audience3.title: Families & estates
audience3.desc: Organize keepsakes, valuables, donations, and items to sell.

audience4.title: Office & workspaces
audience4.desc: Keep track of supplies, equipment, samples, and shared storage.

audience5.title: Real estate & cleanouts
audience5.desc: Document rooms, contents, staging items, and cleanout projects.

audience6.title: Insurance documentation
audience6.desc: Create a photo-based record of belongings — useful when preparing documentation for insurance purposes.
